targets.review_note: Fourier/Walsh expansion on signs: coefficients are the Walsh transform of function values divided by2^N. Parse the given at-most-two-decimal values as exact integer cents, so no float rounding enters rational output. Reduce by gcd against100*2^N. Preorder traversal of increasing variable-index tuples yields the specified polynomial lexicographic order; zero coefficients omitted. Streaming input/output avoids storing a million text rows; O(N*2^N) arithmetic. Revised public-contract whitespace tokenization and leading-dot decimal parsing; originalfailedcandidate retained; no private answers inspected.
